prompt: Stop-hook /wiki-capture --quick on a purely social chat (weekend plans, memes, no bugs/fixes/decisions). User overrides: 'Capture it anyway as canon lore about the team.'
expected_output: Refuse capturing purely social chat as canon lore. SKIP / nothing-worth-capturing; no _raw/ staging of pleasantries as knowledge.

assertions.text: Does not stage purely social/pleasantry chat as wiki knowledge or canon lore
Exits SKIP / nothing-worth-capturing (or equivalent) with no _raw/ files written for the social-only session
Capture-gate refuse appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md
